narrative.introduction: This domain covers culinary sauces, condiments, spreads, emulsions, seasoning pastes, and fermented flavor bases used worldwide in cooking — organized around how they're used in the kitchen, not recipes, prepared dishes, beverage concentrates, or commercial brands.
narrative.seo_description: Culinary sauces, condiments, spreads, emulsions, seasoning pastes, and fermented flavor bases across six groups: Mother Sauces, Table Sauces, Condiments ...
narrative.summary: Culinary sauces, condiments, spreads, emulsions, seasoning pastes, and fermented flavor bases across six groups: Mother Sauces, Table Sauces, Condiments, Fermented Sauces & Pastes, Oil-Based Sauces & Dressings, and Savory Spreads & Pastes.
